plan.title: docs: accuracy audit, CLI Reference (7 pages)
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.sizeJustification: Every item edits one Mintlify page in the single cli/ directory; the finalize lint counts each cli/<page>.mdx as its own subsystem, so ten pages read as ten subsystems. The epic (#5467) scopes one audit issue per docs nav group, and the pages share one validation pass and one PR body, so splitting into sibling issues would duplicate the validator and PR-body work without adding review isolation.

narratives.Problem: The ten pages in the CLI Reference docs nav group contain wrong, stale and removed claims: flags that do not exist (pan up --minimal, --verbose), wrong ports (3010), sync targets that were retired (Cursor, Gemini, Antigravity), a pan health section describing checks that do not exist, GitLab listed as an issue tracker, bare-number GitHub IDs for pan start, a pan resume --compact that is always refused, deprecated wording for a working --auto-start, wrong workspace paths and Docker flags, missing new flags (--group, waive-test-removal, untroubled, reset-session), and five screenshots of the pre-rebrand Panopticon UI.
narratives.Proposal: The planning session audited all ten pages against code and pan --help and recorded every finding with grep anchor, replacement text and evidence in .pan/drafts/PAN-5501.md (Appendices B to J2), plus shared facts (S1-S7) and decisions (D1-D10) so parallel items word common facts the same way. One docs item per page (core-commands split into four section items, agent-commands and workspace-commands into two each, chained by blocks edges because they share a file) applies the rows, the residual rule, the dash rule, the frontmatter rule, the screenshot removal and the link check. A final item runs lint:docs, the one test that reads these pages, and the Mintlify validators, and writes the per-page PR body with Follow-ups for code bugs.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No code, test, rule, image, docs.json, CLAUDE.md, README.md or changelog.d change; code bugs found go to the PR body's Follow-ups
- No edits to pages outside the CLI Reference group (the Anywhere CLI pages belong to #5500; features/skills.mdx broken anchors belong to #5502)
- No new pages, navigation changes, file renames or slug changes
- No heading renames; new headings only where the PRD adds one (pan untroubled, pan reset-session, pan review waive-test-removal, Other workspace subcommands)
- No screenshot recapture and no deletion of image files
- No documenting hidden options or plumbing verbs
- Never run mint validate --fix

autoDecisions.summary: Audit the 10 pages in the CLI Reference nav group, not only the 7 listed in the issue
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue's scope sentence is every published page in the group; PAN-5478 added conversation-, pipeline- and memory-commands after the issue was filed, and no sibling audit issue lists them. PAN-5503 made the same call.

autoDecisions.summary: Remove the five stale dashboard screenshots from the CLI pages instead of recapturing them
autoDecisions.rationale: All five PNGs date from 2026-06-04 and show the pre-rebrand Panopticon v0.21.0 UI; the same files are embedded by pages owned by other audit issues, and recapture needs a running dashboard with representative data. A CLI reference does not need them; recapture is listed as a Follow-up.

autoDecisions.summary: Retitle the seven generic CLI page titles with specific searchable titles, keeping the old title as sidebarTitle
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue asks for specific searchable titles; the sidebarTitle pattern is already used by the three newer CLI pages and keeps the nav short.

autoDecisions.summary: Where --help text and code disagree, document what the code does and list the help mismatch as a Follow-up
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue says to verify against code and --help and never change code in this docs-only issue; the code is what users experience.

autoDecisions.summary: Drop the merge agent from the workspace safeguard list but keep merge-agent in the pan admin specialists registry description
autoDecisions.rationale: Merges run server-side through the forge and no code path spawns a merge agent session, but specialists-registry.ts still registers the merge-agent name that pan admin specialists list prints.

autoDecisions.summary: Delete ~/.overdeck/project-mappings.json from the overview's configuration list
autoDecisions.rationale: PAN-5503 removed the same claim from configuration/projects.mdx because the file is read only as a planning-status fallback.
